# edit-agent-dashboard — playbook index

Playbooks for the `edit-agent-dashboard` Platform Skill. The bundled `SKILL.md` routes to one of these based on the request classification (Case A / B / C).

## Case playbooks (pick the smallest that satisfies the request)

- [case-rename.md](case-rename.md) — **Case A**: rename / relabel / reorder / change layout / remove a phase or view. YAML-only edits, no code changes.
- [case-reuse.md](case-reuse.md) — **Case B**: add a new tab/view that REUSES a route already wired in `manage.yaml`. No plugin rebuild.
- [case-new-route.md](case-new-route.md) — **Case C**: generate a NEW plugin handler + route for a new data destination. Modifies plugin TS, rebuilds, restarts gateway. Most invasive.

## Cross-cutting

- [safety-rollback.md](safety-rollback.md) — Read BEFORE starting Case C. Executed on ANY failure during Case C (build error, restart timeout, 404).
- [view-types.yaml](view-types.yaml) — Schema reference for every supported View type (`list-view`, `data-import`, `textarea-edit-multi-section`, `leads-view`). REQUIRED read before authoring any new view.

## Handler templates (Case C only)

- [handler-templates/read-handler.ts.tmpl](handler-templates/read-handler.ts.tmpl) — GET handler skeleton.
- [handler-templates/write-handler.ts.tmpl](handler-templates/write-handler.ts.tmpl) — POST/PUT handler skeleton.
- [handler-templates/path-safety-helper.ts.tmpl](handler-templates/path-safety-helper.ts.tmpl) — Path sanitization helper (escape-traversal). Always include when adding a handler that touches files.
- [handler-templates/registration-snippet.ts.tmpl](handler-templates/registration-snippet.ts.tmpl) — Snippet to register the new handler in `operation-routes.ts`.

## Fetch order recommended by the router

1. Always: [view-types.yaml](view-types.yaml) if any new view is added.
2. Always: the single `case-*.md` matching the classified request.
3. Case C only: [safety-rollback.md](safety-rollback.md) + the relevant handler templates.

Other files in this skill's bundle (lock, diff-before-write, backup) are enforced by the bundled `SKILL.md` itself — no playbook to fetch.
